/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
lock_dir='/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock'
mkdir -p '/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks'
while "'! mkdir "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done
lock_pid=$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$lock_pid" > "$lock_dir/pid"
cleanup_lake_lock() {
  if test -f "$lock_dir/pid" && test "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock_dir/pid")" = "$lock_pid"; then
    unlink "$lock_dir/pid"
    rmdir "$lock_dir"
  fi
}
trap cleanup_lake_lock EXIT
lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.IdealSheafAffineComap
lake build
'

   266	/-! ### The twist lies over `Spec k`
   267	
   268	This is what makes `γ ≫ π` still satisfy the DD-R compatibility `hpi`: a linear substitution
   269	is `k`-linear, hence the identity in degree zero, so it commutes with `Proj 𝒜 ⟶ Spec (𝒜 0)`. -/
   270	
   271	theorem autOfMatrix_comp_toSpecZero (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) :
   272	    autOfMatrix k M ≫ Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 = Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 := by
   273	  have h := Proj.map_comp_toSpecZero (substGradedHom (mat M))
   274	    (irrelevant_le_map_substGradedHom k M)
   275	  rw [substGradedHom_gradedZeroRingHom] at h
   276	  simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id, Category.comp_id] at h
   277	  exact h
   278	
   279	/-- **The twist is a morphism over `Spec k`.** -/
   280	theorem autOfMatrix_comp_structureMap (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) :
   281	    autOfMatrix k M ≫ structureMap k = structureMap k := by
   282	  change autOfMatrix k M ≫ Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 ≫
   283	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (𝒜 0))) = _
   284	  rw [← Category.assoc, autOfMatrix_comp_toSpecZero]
   285	  rfl
   286	
   287	/-! ### The twisted charts
   288	
   289	The twist `γ = autOfMatrix M` pulls the standard chart `D₊(Xᵢ)` back to the basic open of the
   290	linear form `ℓᵢ = ∑ⱼ Mᵢⱼ Xⱼ` — the `i`-th row of `M`. These twisted charts are again affine and
   291	again cover `P¹_k`. -/
   292	
   293	/-- The `i`-th twisted coordinate `ℓᵢ = ∑ⱼ Mᵢⱼ Xⱼ`. -/
   294	noncomputable def twistedCoord (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) (i : Fin 2) :
   295	    MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k :=
   296	  matrixLinearForm (mat M) i
   297	
   298	theorem twistedCoord_mem (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) (i : Fin 2) :
   299	    twistedCoord k M i ∈ 𝒜 1 :=
   300	  matrixLinearForm_mem _ i
   301	
   302	/-- **The twisted chart.** `γ⁻¹(D₊(Xᵢ)) = D₊(ℓᵢ)`, where `ℓᵢ` is the `i`-th row form of `M`.
   303	This is free: `Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen` holds by `rfl`. -/
   304	theorem autOfMatrix_preimage_chartOpen (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) (i : Fin 2) :
   305	    autOfMatrix k M ⁻¹ᵁ chartOpen k i = Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (twistedCoord k M i) := by
   306	  have h : autOfMatrix k M ⁻¹ᵁ chartOpen k i =
   307	      Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (substGradedHom (mat M) (X i)) := rfl
   308	  rw [h, substGradedHom_apply, substAlgHom_X]

   311	/-- Each twisted chart is an affine open, directly from `Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen`

   313	theorem isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen (M : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) k) (i : Fin 2) :

   315	  rw [autOfMatrix_preimage_chartOpen]

      (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y'))

    have hres₂ : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
        (D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y' ≤

    have e₂ := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (relCurveMap C R R') hle

        d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y') ≤

/-! ## The pulled-back local-equation system -/

/-- The pullback of a local-equation system `E` along a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X`, under the
side-hypothesis `hreg` that the pulled-back equations are regular (their germs are
nonzerodivisors at every point of their member).

The equations are the `f`-pullbacks `pullbackEqn f E y` of the equations of `E`, living on
the pulled-back pointed cover `E.cover.pullback f`. Regularity is supplied by `hreg` — it is
not automatic, since pulling a nonzerodivisor back along a non-flat morphism may produce a
zerodivisor. The overlap ratios are the `f`-pullbacks of the ratios of `E`, hence units. -/

    (hreg : ∀ (y z : Y) (hz : z ∈ (E.cover.pullback f).opens y),

        ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Y.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    Y.LocalEquations where
  cover := E.cover.pullback f
  eqn y := pullbackEqn f E y
  regular := hreg

    ⟨f.unitsAppLE (E.cover.opens (f.base y) ⊓ E.cover.opens (f.base y'))

        (f.le_preimage_inf inf_le_left inf_le_right)
        (E.ratioUnit (f.base y) (f.base y')),
      pullback_ratio_eq f E y y'⟩
